propositions: Mapping configuration block must be registered as a reserved section in _RESERVED_SECTIONS and read raw via read_reserved_section without triggering unknown-key warnings or coercion
Axis maps (status_map, type_map, link_map, priority_map, create_defaults) must deep-merge per key with precedence: built-in ← default ← projects.<KEY>, allowing partial overrides
Vocabulary declarations (statuses, issue_types, link_types lists and hierarchy table) must replace wholesale per layer, with most-specific winning and no union of layers

Configuration must validate fail-closed offline: every axis-map value must exist in its declared vocabulary, malformed blocks must raise MappingConfigError, and capability-absent axis references must be rejected
A provider-neutral mapping_config module must define schema, Capability descriptor, and validation logic without importing any jira adapter code or Jira-specific literals
The reserved mapping section and projects.json store are orthogonal concerns, both keyed by Jira project key but serving distinct purposes (vocabulary/semantics vs. project identity)
